cases.input: Create a cross-domain contract-level E2E benchmark for active user-facing orchestrators and protect their dependency and artifact boundaries.
requiredBehaviors: derive every scenario sequence from the canonical entrypoint requires closure
require current passing evaluations for all active benchmark participants
distinguish contract-level architecture evidence from actual artifact execution
forbiddenBehaviors: claim render runtime or artifact execution from a structural contract check alone
skillAnchors: Kein grüner Benchmark auf roter oder fehlender Skill-Evaluation

cases.input: A shared delivery refactor moved document and image workers behind learning-delivery-workflow, but an older benchmark lists those workers directly in every YouTube top-level sequence.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the shared delivery orchestration boundary
remove direct top-level worker bypasses from the benchmark sequence
bind the regression to the current delegated architecture rather than legacy topology
forbiddenBehaviors: restore direct renderer dependencies merely to keep a stale benchmark green

cases.input: A proposed benchmark includes a deprecated compatibility facade and a skill with no passing evaluation, then labels the whole path production-proven.
requiredBehaviors: fail the active sequence when it regresses to deprecated or compatibility-only capability
fail when required evaluation evidence is absent or red
reject production-proven wording when no executable artifact gate was run
forbiddenBehaviors: invent passing benchmark evidence to compensate for missing skill evaluation or runtime proof
